title: [web] Include bashDeny in the editor's whole-config payload (closes the data-loss todo 2 exists to prevent)
commit_message: fix(web): preserve bashDeny through whole-config policy saves

defect.summary: The editor PATCHes the WHOLE policy config but its payload type was {permission, correction, tools}; EffectivePermission.bashDeny was declared but never read, so any save silently dropped config.bashDeny (introduced/guarded by todo 2 6b057f7).
defect.live_before_after: Orchestrator-verified live: a policy created with bashDeny:['rm -rf /'] stored fine; a PATCH with the EXACT editor payload shape dropped it. Cleaned up.

changes: EffectivePermission.bashDeny widened/narrowed from `unknown` to `string[]` (server resolveBashDeny guarantees a string array)

sync effect: conditional spread `...(Array.isArray(bashDeny) && bashDeny.length > 0 ? { bashDeny } : {})` — EMPTINESS check is required because the server ALWAYS materialises an array (`[]` fallback via ROLE_BASH_DENY_PATTERNS), never `undefined`; Array.isArray alone would inject bashDeny:[] into every save and fail the negative control
both write paths (native debounce + tool toggle) build via `{...cur}` spreads → bashDeny preserved; verified by reading, and behaviourally by the test
implementation.deliberate_deviation: Todo 4's fence 'Must NOT change the payload shape' predates todo 2's field; todo 2's whole-config-preservation mandate supersedes it for this ONE key. The endpoint (PATCH /execution-policies/:id) and the `{config:{...}}` envelope are unchanged.

empirical_finding_that_changed_the_spec.observation: GET /agents -> effectivePermission.bashDeny is ALWAYS present and is ALWAYS an array ([] when the stored config lacks the key) — resolveBashDeny(config.bashDeny) falls back to ROLE_BASH_DENY_PATTERNS (currently []) at execution-policy.service.ts:330-334.
empirical_finding_that_changed_the_spec.implication: The literal `Array.isArray(bashDeny)` presence check from the task text would always be true and would materialise `bashDeny: []` into every PATCH, violating the required negative control ('bashDeny' in config === false). The implemented discriminator is non-empty array.
